The Ring of Yoba has a chance of giving the Yoba's Blessing
after the player takes damage. The Yoba's Blessing buff grants immunity to monster-based damage for 5 seconds. It does not protect against damage caused by falling down
The chance of receiving the buff is increased by low health and by

buffs, but not daily Luck. It can activate once the player's health drops below 90. After that, it increases linearly until 15 health, below which an additive 20% bonus to the activation chance applies. This is calculated as (0.9 - HP / 100) / (3 - floor(Luck Level / 10)) + Bonus where Bonus is 0.2 if health is 15 or less. For 0
and 100 max health, this means 50-45% activation chance between 0 HP and 15 HP and 25%-0% activation chance between 16 HP and 90 HP.
Equipping a second Ring of Yoba provides no additional benefit.
